intro.text: Someone working for Brightlord Paladar in the humans' bunker in Revolar while the singers hold the city.

items.text: Ked arranged the guard at Paladar's tents and had put Guff on duty. When Guff brought Moash before the brightlord and Moash wouldn't answer his questions, Paladar had Guff beaten and told Ked to post someone else, warning that Ked would be beaten too if the replacement did no better.
